name: Balls V1 Total
author: AAidalol
description: One of the hardest challenges coming from Aida's 2024 era, other than Hard Wave and UNeedBallsToPlayThis. Also the level that Balls V1 Total V2 is a remake of. Not much to say about it, a pretty straightforward precision based challenge with a weird ship gimmick in the beginning. Hardest part is 0-25.
